talents.name: Hit Point Bonus
talents.description: Gain +2 hit points per rank.

talents.name: Tough as Nails
talents.description: Use a d12p for Threshold of Pain checks.

talents.name: Tough Hide
talents.description: Gain +1 damage reduction to any wound.

talents.name: Attack Bonus (weapon)
talents.description: Gain +1 attack bonus with a chosen melee weapon. May be taken multiple times but only once per weapon.

talents.name: Damage Bonus (weapon)
talents.description: Gain +1 damage bonus with a chosen melee weapon. May be taken multiple times but only once per weapon.

talents.name: Parry Bonus (weapon)
talents.description: Gain +1 defense bonus with a chosen melee weapon. May be taken multiple times but only once per weapon.

talents.name: Dodge
talents.description: Gain +1 to your Defense roll. Additionally, possessing this talent permits the defender to add the Defense modifier provided by Dexterity (assuming the defender can see the approaching missile). Note that if a defender with the Dodge talent and a shield opts to use the shield to deflect missiles, the Dodge benefits do not apply.

talents.name: Advanced Sighting
talents.description: Mitigate distance penalties on Accuracy with ranged weapons. Treat targets as if only two-thirds their effective (size-modified) distance. Example: a man 60 feet away is treated as 40 feet.

talents.name: Armor Focus
talents.description: Negates the penalty to initiative from wearing armor.

talents.name: Armor Specialization
talents.description: Negates the penalty to speed from wearing armor.

talents.name: Armor Master
talents.description: Increases the damage reduction worn armor grants you by 1.

talents.name: Blind-Fighting
talents.description: Fight in poor or no light. In total darkness, suffer only a -4 penalty to attack (instead of -8). In extremely dim illumination, incur only a -2 penalty. No Defense penalties due to darkness or inability to see within melee distance. Effective only against threats within melee distance. No protection from missile fire or threats outside melee range. You may walk safely in darkness. Reduces attack penalty versus invisible creatures to -4, but does not allow precise targeting.

talents.name: Blind-Shooting
talents.description: Fire at opponents you cannot see. Dimly lit targets suffer -2 accuracy; completely blind shots are -6. The target may employ a shield for cover if held at the ready. The GM compares the attack roll versus true distance and applies cover if applicable.

talents.name: Cleave
talents.description: If you drop a creature, you get an immediate extra melee attack against another creature within reach. The extra attack is with the same weapon and bonus. Usable once per second.

talents.name: Combat Expertise
talents.description: Improves the Fight Defensively special combat move, halving the attack penalty from -2/4/6/8 to -1/2/3/4.

talents.name: Combat Reflexes
talents.description: Attack an opponent who performs the Flee special combat move, even if you are not due to act and are engaged by other foes.

talents.name: Crack Shot (weapon)
talents.description: Gain +1 attack with a chosen ranged weapon. May be taken multiple times but only once per weapon.

talents.name: Deceptive Defender
talents.description: Gain +1 Defense bonus versus an opponent's initial attack; subsequent attacks by the same opponent do not gain this bonus. If an opponent declares a Called Shot, increase their delay to 4d4p seconds and gain an additional +4 Defense versus that called shot.

talents.name: Double Weapon Focus
talents.description: Reduce the unmodified base speed of double weapons by 1.

talents.name: Double Weapon Specialization
talents.description: Treat double weapons as normal weapons for style matching: battle axes for double axes, scimitars for double scimitars, scythes for dual scythes, military picks for hooked hammers, staves for monk's spades, spears and battle axes for spear-axes, and longswords for two-bladed swords.

talents.name: Double Weapon Master
talents.description: Treat double weapons as size M instead of size L for handedness and minimum speed. Allows aggressive two-weapon fighting while using a shield.

talents.name: Greased Lightning (weapon)
talents.description: Gain -1 Speed bonus for a chosen ranged weapon (subject to the weapon's minimum speed). May be taken multiple times but only once per weapon.

talents.name: Great Cleave
talents.description: Removes the once per second restriction from Cleave, allowing multiple cleaves if you continue to drop enemies within one second.

talents.name: Heavy Armor Optimization
talents.description: While wearing heavy armor, add one quarter of your armor's damage reduction (rounded down) to melee damage. If critically hit by a hacking or piercing weapon, ignore all ancillary critical hit effects.

talents.name: Improved Critical (weapon group)
talents.description: You can inflict critical hits on a natural 19 in addition to a natural 20, but do not automatically hit on a 19. Your modified total attack must still exceed the modified total defense.

talents.name: Improved Reach (weapon group)
talents.description: Increase effective reach by 1 foot for a chosen weapon group (select a weapon from that group). If this makes your reach longer than your opponent's, you strike first; ties still go to the inherently longer weapon. May be taken again for a different weapon group.

talents.name: Light Armor Optimization
talents.description: While wearing light armor, add half of your armor's damage reduction (rounded down) to your defense. Halve extra damage taken from critical hits.

talents.name: Medium Armor Optimization
talents.description: While wearing medium armor, increase armor damage reduction by 1 and reduce its defense penalty by 1. Reduce severity of received critical hits by 10.

talents.name: Mobility
talents.description: Give Ground and Scamper Back may still be used against opponents whose superior speed would normally prevent these maneuvers.

talents.name: One-Upsmanship
talents.description: In melee, when attacker and defender tie, you may gain +1 Attack to land a blow if you have at least Average Honor and your foe is in a lower honor category. Must deliver a catchy, snarky, or distinctive catch phrase.

talents.name: Power Attack
talents.description: When attacking with a melee weapon, you may ignore beneficial attack modifiers from Intelligence and Dexterity to double your Strength damage modifier. Cannot be used with weapons smaller than your size.

talents.name: Precision Aiming
talents.description: For called shots, reduce delay time to 1-2 seconds and halve the passive defense bonus normally given to targets. No benefit when aiming center of mass.

talents.name: Precision Combatant
talents.description: Called shots incur a d4p second delay during which you take only a -2 defense penalty. Opponents receive only half the normal defense bonus for a called shot.

talents.name: Shield Focus
talents.description: Gain a +1 defense bonus while using shields.

talents.name: Shield Specialization
talents.description: Reduce the cover value of your shield by 5, removing the need to actively crouch behind it for full projectile protection.

talents.name: Shield Master
talents.description: Improve the Arc of Defense of shields: bucklers to two frontal attackers, small shields to all frontal and flank attackers, and medium/large/tower shields to all frontal, flank, and rear attackers.

talents.name: Spring Attack
talents.description: Tactical Move no longer penalizes attack, only defense.

talents.name: Swift (weapon or shield)
talents.description: Gain -1 Speed with a chosen melee weapon or shield. May be taken multiple times but only once per implement.

talents.name: Armeroci Pole
talents.description: The Armeroci do not simply wield weapons, they draw circles of death around themselves, and dare others to cross the line. Your reach is increased by 1 foot and you deal an extra die of damage on your initial engagement strikes at the cost of increasing your weapon speed by 2. In addition, you always receive an initial engagement strike against foes engaging you, as long as your reach is equivalent or greater than theirs, even if you are already engaged.

talents.name: Crescent Moon
talents.description: Strike to unbalance and disarm, turn every attack into an opening for a counter. When two-weapon fighting defensively with a primary large sword and secondary small sword, your perfect and near-perfect defenses allow you to immediately called shot your opponent's weapon, granting them a +6 to defense, instead of dealing damage. If you hit, your opponent's weapon is flung 2d6p feet in a random direction; results of 4 feet or less mean the weapon falls to the ground beneath them. You also treat natural 18s as near-perfect defenses, or 17s with the Superior Defense talent.

talents.name: Doomrazor
talents.description: It is an art, leaving wounds that seem shallow at first, until the victim realizes too late that the bleeding is happening where no bandage can reach. Do not add your strength or mastery bonus to damage, and no longer penetrate. In exchange, each wound you inflict is accompanied by internal hemorrhaging.

talents.name: Falling Sun
talents.description: It is said that this technique was taught to man by a being forged of light who, shortly after, ascended into the night sky. At the cost of increasing your weapon speed by 2, your attack, defense and damage rolls now penetrate on both the maximum die roll and said roll -1.

talents.name: Fymblwnger
talents.description: Said to originate from giants, warriors using this style are taught to swing as though hurling mountains. Your opponents are no longer afforded a bonus to defense when they Give Ground or Scamper Back.

talents.name: Hammerer
talents.description: Bodies crumpling with each blow, reminding them that resistance has a cost. Your knock-backs always reset your opponent's weapon count.

talents.name: Hobbler
talents.description: If you can't move, you cannot fight. You suffer a -4 penalty to attack, but roll a d2000 for each strike you land. You deal the effects of a critical strike in that location according to the severity of the blow, although without the extra damage dice.

talents.name: Ithican Prince
talents.description: The merchant princes of Ithica prize cleverness above strength. Every step a feint, every strike a lesson. Your intelligence grants half its attack bonus to both damage and defense while using a buckler and small sword.

talents.name: Quiet River
talents.description: A quiet river carves mountains. You deal half damage, but ignore all DR. While not wearing armor or using a shield, your base defense with your bare hands is d20p and you receive double the defense bonus from unarmed weapons mastery. You are not considered armed, however armed opponents do not receive free counterattacks against you.

talents.name: Regenstat
talents.description: The Vetlander sword-duelists train to read the slightest hint of intent. When engaged with a single opponent while using your sword two-handed or one-handed without an offhand, gain +1 to attack and defense each time you successfully attack or defend, maximum +8, resetting upon missing or being hit.

talents.name: Returner
talents.description: Conceived by a warrior-king tired of bloodshed, many wars were settled in single combat with this gambit. Subject yourself to a -4 penalty to your defense and in exchange you may take advantage of your opponent's exposed defenses to attack them as they attack you. You may only do this return attack against one enemy attack between your own attack rolls, but you still suffer the defense penalty against subsequent attacks. In addition, you may forgo your initial attack when engaging and instead deal double damage on your retaliatory attack.

talents.name: Rhdwng Flow
talents.description: Rhdwngers say that force does not begin in the body, but in the earth itself. You may add your full strength bonus to thrown weapons, if applicable, no matter the speed at which you move.

talents.name: Rohavalan Bridge
talents.description: A ceaseless cascade, one blow flowing into another. Halve your modified weapon speed, minimum weapon speed and reach. However, you must use a 2d4p in place of your weapon's normal damage die if your attack exceeds your opponent's defense by less than 10.

talents.name: Scorn of the Dissendri
talents.description: Two hands, one will. When two-weapon fighting, offensively or defensively, strike with both weapons on the initial engagement hits, perfect defenses and near-perfect defenses.

talents.name: Shield of Blades
talents.description: Be not a man, but a wall wrought of whirling iron. When wielding two one-handed swords defensively, you may use a full d20p plus any defense bonus from both the primary and secondary weapons for all defense rolls against frontal and flank attackers. This bonus may additionally be used against ranged attackers, provided you can see the approaching missile. If you possess the Perfect Two-Weapon Fighting talent, you may use this style and Storm of Blades simultaneously.

talents.name: Six Paths
talents.description: There's an odd calmness to this style. Parry, cut, bash, over and over. When wielding a large sword and either a medium or small shield, your shield is only hit within 5 of the defense roll instead of 10. Furthermore, each successful strike you land permits you a free shield bash attack on the following second.

talents.name: Storm of Blades
talents.description: A relentless cascade of steel, sure to turn any foe into mist. When wielding two one-handed swords offensively, the initial attack of your secondary weapon is always made exactly two seconds after your initial primary attack. Additionally, your subsequent attacks, both primary and secondary, are delayed one second less. If you possess the Perfect Two-Weapon Fighting talent, you may use this style and Shield of Blades simultaneously.

talents.name: Three Mountains
talents.description: West of Caernoth lies a monastery hidden within this technique's namesake, what it has to do with it, I do not know. If you strike the same creature three times in a row without missing, it must make a Physical Saving Throw against your most recent adjusted attack roll or automatically take 20 on its next Trauma save.

talents.name: Unbreakable Wall
talents.description: The blow meets the shield, and dies there. Large or tower shields you wield gain +2 DR. You know how to lean your body into your shield, reducing the damage dealt to your shield by its DR for the purposes of breakage.

talents.name: Twelve Paths
talents.description: Ask a dozen Twelve Paths students how to defend yourself, and you'll get a dozen different answers. It's all very philosophical until you have to fight one. At the cost of a -3 penalty to damage, you are able to wield both a size L large sword and either a small shield or buckler in conjunction, combining your defense modifiers from both your weapon and shield against all attackers in your arc of defense. In addition, your next attack comes two seconds sooner each time an opponent strikes your shield, immediately attacking if this reduces your weapon count to the current second.

talents.name: Two-Weapon Fighting
talents.description: When using two one-handed weapons offensively, you no longer suffer a -2 penalty to damage with the secondary weapon.

talents.name: Improved Two-Weapon Fighting
talents.description: Subsequent attacks with the primary weapon are made on its weapon speed plus one.

talents.name: Greater Two-Weapon Fighting
talents.description: Subsequent attacks with the secondary weapon are made after a delay of its weapon speed plus one.

talents.name: Perfect Two-Weapon Fighting
talents.description: Combine the best of both two one-handed weapon fighting styles: attack frequency of attacking with both weapons and the superior defense of defending with both weapons.

talents.name: Weapon Focus (weapon group)
talents.description: Reduce your base weapon experience threshold by 20% for the chosen weapon group.

talents.name: Whirlwind Attack
talents.description: Gain access to the Whirlwind Attack special combat move: strike all nearby creatures within reach with a single attack roll, increasing weapon speed by 5 seconds after all other modifiers. If defenders use Give Ground or Scamper Back, they take half damage. Cannot be combined with other special combat moves until your next attack opportunity.

talents.name: Age Gracefully
talents.description: Retain a youthful appearance as you age; hair may gray but severe wrinkling and sagging are resisted. Details on adverse aging effects are at the GM's discretion.

talents.name: Fast Healer
talents.description: Each wound point heals half a day faster, except the final point which heals in 6 hours.

talents.name: Forgettable Face
talents.description: NPCs have a 10% chance to recall details unless you had a meaningful conversation; then base chance is 85%. Modify by +5% per previous encounter and -1% per week since last encounter.

talents.name: Heightened Immunity
talents.description: Gain a +2 bonus to communicability and severity checks against disease.

talents.name: Improved Awareness
talents.description: Roll a superior initiative die, improving the die type by one step (d12, d10, d8, d6, d4, d3).

talents.name: Inoculation (disease)
talents.description: Requires surviving the specified disease. Gain +7 to communicability and severity checks against that disease.

talents.name: Less Sleep
talents.description: Require only three hours of sleep for normal mental functioning.

talents.name: Long Distance Running
talents.description: Requires Hiking/Roadmarching proficiency. In open plains, cover 40 miles/day; each day requires a Constitution check to maintain pace. Failure drops you to 20 miles/day until a successful check. Critical failure causes injury requiring 1d4p days rest (walking at 10 miles/day worsens it). In impeded terrain, cover 15 miles/day; no benefit in restricted terrain.

talents.name: No Accent
talents.description: Speak any language you know without revealing your native accent.

talents.name: Pain Tolerant
talents.description: Gain a +10% bonus when calculating your Threshold of Pain.

talents.name: Poison Resistant
talents.description: Gain a +1 bonus to the contested poison resistance check (d20 + Constitution). May be taken multiple times; each additional purchase costs 4 BP more than the previous.

talents.name: Polyglot
talents.description: Gain double Mastery Die rolls for each Language purchase and a +2 bonus to each Mastery Die.

talents.name: Resolute
talents.description: When a blow drops you to 0 or fewer hit points (but not death), you may attempt a Constitution check to regain d8 hit points for 30 + 5d12p seconds; without healing, you collapse afterward.

talents.name: Stout
talents.description: Count as one size category larger for determining the force required to knock you back.

talents.name: Bridled Rage
talents.description: Requires 5th level and either HackLust or HackFrenzy. When HackLust or HackFrenzy triggers, you may choose to pass or fail the Wisdom check to resist entering rage. At 10th level, you may choose to pass or fail the Wisdom check to end rage. At 13th level, you will not attack allies if no foes remain, instead sprinting to seek new foes. Barbarian requirements and Magic Phobia apply (see references/barbarian.md).

talents.name: Controlled Rampage
talents.description: Requires 8th level and either HackLust or HackFrenzy. While raging, you no longer need to hack at a downed opponent's corpse and may move on immediately. At 17th level, opponents can no longer near-perfect defense twice as often when you are HackFrenzied. Barbarian requirements and Magic Phobia apply (see references/barbarian.md).

talents.name: Hardened
talents.description: Threshold of Pain becomes 30% of max hit points plus 2% per level. Reduce base Fatigue Factor by 2. Barbarian requirements and Magic Phobia apply (see references/barbarian.md).

talents.name: Hearty
talents.description: Gain +5 hit points. Gain a +1 saving throw bonus versus poison and magic for every 3 full points of Constitution. Barbarian requirements and Magic Phobia apply (see references/barbarian.md).

talents.name: Natural Strength
talents.description: When battling natural animals while wearing light or no armor, reduce the animal's damage reduction by 1 per level. Gain +2 damage in unarmed combat regardless of foe. Strength counts as two points higher when calculating jumping distance. Barbarian requirements and Magic Phobia apply (see references/barbarian.md).

talents.name: Supreme Cleave
talents.description: Requires 12th level and Cleave. You may use the Tactical Move maneuver without foregoing any extra cleave attacks. Barbarian requirements and Magic Phobia apply (see references/barbarian.md).

talents.name: Supreme Power Attack
talents.description: Requires 15th level and Power Attack. You may triple your Strength damage modifier while power attacking instead of doubling it. Barbarian requirements and Magic Phobia apply (see references/barbarian.md).

talents.name: Bardic Knowledge
talents.description: Bards sometimes know useless bits of trivia and background history (4% chance per level, subject to the GM's secret percentile roll). Bard requirements apply (see references/bard.md).

talents.name: Bardic Music
talents.description: Use music or poetics to inspire yourself and allies who can hear you. Each use lasts up to five minutes and ends if you cast spells, speak, or stop vocalizing. Playing an instrument amplifies the effect and requires both hands free; the instrument can be stopped without ending the performance as long as you continue vocalizing, but the bonus is lost. Retrieving or stowing an instrument takes d4p+1 seconds. Each talent requiring Bardic Music grants two additional uses per day. Bard requirements apply (see references/bard.md).

talents.name: Dual Performance
talents.description: Requires 18th level, Bardic Music, and any two other talents requiring Bardic Music. Perform two different Bardic Music effects at once; this counts as two uses. Bard requirements apply (see references/bard.md).

talents.name: Inspire Courage
talents.description: Requires 2nd level and Bardic Music. Grant yourself and allies +1 to morale modifier, attack rolls, and damage rolls. Using an instrument improves this by another +1. At 10th level, improves to +2 (+3 with an instrument). Bard requirements apply (see references/bard.md).

talents.name: Inspire Competence
talents.description: Requires 4th level and Bardic Music. Grant one ally +10% to a specific skill while they can hear the music; some skills cannot be bolstered. Using an instrument improves this by another +10%. At 12th level, improves to +20% (+30% with an instrument). Bard requirements apply (see references/bard.md).

talents.name: Inspire Greatness
talents.description: Requires 6th level and Bardic Music. Grant yourself and a number of allies equal to one third your level (rounded down) +1 damage reduction. Using an instrument improves this by another +1. At 14th level, improves to +2 (+3 with an instrument). Bard requirements apply (see references/bard.md).

talents.name: Inspire Heroics
talents.description: Requires 8th level and Bardic Music. Grant yourself and allies +1 to physical, dodge, and mental saving throw modifiers, and defense bonus. Using an instrument improves this by another +1. At 16th level, improves to +2 (+3 with an instrument). Bard requirements apply (see references/bard.md).

talents.name: Horn of the Commander
talents.description: Requires 8th level. The horn cannot be used while engaged in melee and requires a free hand. Each horn ability takes d3p seconds to blow and requires 6 seconds to recover breath afterward; horn/voice cannot be used while recovering or without a horn. Rally: halve remaining trauma duration (rounded up) for allies within earshot. Call to Battle (10th): surprised allies within earshot reduce Starting Initiative to current Count Up. Sound of Glory (12th): allies within earshot gain -5 on trauma checks for 60 seconds. Thunderous Blast (14th): 3d4p damage in a 60 ft. cone; commander rolls d20p + level vs targets' Physical Saving Throws to negate damage. Commander requirements apply (see references/commander.md).

talents.name: Voice of the Commander
talents.description: Voice can affect only targets who can hear and understand you. Each ability takes d3p seconds to shout and requires 6 seconds to recover breath; horn/voice cannot be used while recovering. Encourage: ally's next attack within 6 seconds rolls twice, take better. Provoke (6th): d20p + level vs target's Mental Saving Throw to force it to attack you for 6 seconds; if resisted, target is immune until next day. Commanding Shout (11th): ally between attacks speeds next attack by up to 4 seconds. Warcry (16th): enemies within earshot must make a morale check; success grants immunity until next day. Commander requirements apply (see references/commander.md).

talents.name: Critical Mastery (weapon group)
talents.description: Requires 15th level and Improved Critical. Critical strikes occur on a natural 18, 19, or 20 with the chosen weapon group. Fighter requirements apply (see references/fighter.md).

talents.name: Hardened
talents.description: Threshold of Pain becomes 30% of max hit points plus 2% per level. Reduce base Fatigue Factor by 2. Fighter requirements apply (see references/fighter.md).

talents.name: Unbreakable
talents.description: Requires 11th level and Tough Hide. Improve the Tough Hide damage reduction bonus by +1. Fighter requirements apply (see references/fighter.md).

talents.name: Weapon Specialization (weapon group)
talents.description: Requires Weapon Focus with the specified weapon group. Gain +2d6p on weapon experience dice rolls with the chosen group. Fighter requirements apply (see references/fighter.md).

talents.name: Weapon Supremacy (weapon group)
talents.description: Requires Weapon Specialization with the specified weapon group. Increase the maximum mastery tier from +5 to +6 with the chosen group. Fighter requirements apply (see references/fighter.md).

talents.name: Whirlwind Mastery
talents.description: Requires 9th level and Whirlwind Attack. Use Whirlwind Attack with no speed penalty. At 15th level, defenders take full damage even if they Give Ground or Scamper Back. Fighter requirements apply (see references/fighter.md).

talents.name: Wounding Criticals (weapon group)
talents.description: Requires 11th level and Improved Critical. Increase Wound Severity by 3 on critical hits with the chosen weapon group. May be purchased twice to increase Wound Severity by 6 total. Fighter requirements apply (see references/fighter.md).

talents.name: Chivalry
talents.description: Heroic deeds are the meat and drink of knights. Knights in Great Honor or higher gain Chivalry Points equal to half their level each day, usable to modify combat-related rolls at epic moments. Knight requirements and restrictions apply (see references/knight.md).

talents.name: Devastating Charge
talents.description: When striking while galloping, double damage dice with all weapons except lances. Lances gain one additional damage die before doubling. Knight requirements and restrictions apply (see references/knight.md).

talents.name: Hardened
talents.description: Threshold of Pain becomes 30% of max hit points plus 2% per level. Reduce base Fatigue Factor by 2. Knight requirements and restrictions apply (see references/knight.md).

talents.name: Inspire Others
talents.description: Allies within 10 feet of an active knight gain +4 to saving throws versus fear, fatigue, and morale. Knight requirements and restrictions apply (see references/knight.md).

talents.name: Intimidate Adversary
talents.description: Requires Inspire Others. Sentient opponents within 10 feet suffer -2 on attack rolls, saving throws, fatigue checks, and morale checks. Knight requirements and restrictions apply (see references/knight.md).

talents.name: Mounted Champion
talents.description: Add half your total defense modifier (rounded down, excluding mounted bonus) to your mount's defense. Knight requirements and restrictions apply (see references/knight.md).

talents.name: Mounted Juggernaut
talents.description: Use two-handed weapons and fighting styles while mounted. Gain an extra damage die (two for mounted weapons) against any size creature instead of only size M. Knight requirements and restrictions apply (see references/knight.md).

talents.name: Mounted Mobility
talents.description: Double degrees you can turn while mounted, with and without ride checks. Slide-stop maneuvers allow a 180-degree turn and immediate gallop instead of canter. Knight requirements and restrictions apply (see references/knight.md).

talents.name: Mounted Protector
talents.description: When your mount is attacked, you may remove your mounted Defense bonus for 10 seconds and grant +6 Defense to your mount for the same duration. Knight requirements and restrictions apply (see references/knight.md).

talents.name: Ambush
talents.description: Launch a special ranged or throwing attack against an unaware opponent, inflicting penetrating damage on the max die roll and the roll minus 1. At 17th level, also apply penetrating damage on the roll minus 2. Ranger requirements apply (see references/ranger.md).

talents.name: Beastmaster
talents.description: Gain one free roll of Animal Empathy and Animal Training with the appropriate mastery die at each level; retroactive upon purchase. Ranger requirements apply (see references/ranger.md).

talents.name: Camouflage
talents.description: Gain a +50 bonus to hiding and sneaking checks in natural surroundings. Ranger requirements apply (see references/ranger.md).

talents.name: Hardened
talents.description: Threshold of Pain becomes 30% of max hit points plus 2% per level. Reduce base Fatigue Factor by 2. Ranger requirements apply (see references/ranger.md).

talents.name: Pathfinder
talents.description: Gain a third attempt to find a trail; at levels 12 and 18 gain a fourth and fifth attempt. Ranger requirements apply (see references/ranger.md).

talents.name: Ranged Critical Mastery (weapon group)
talents.description: Requires 15th level and Improved Critical with a ranged weapon. Critical strikes occur on a natural 18, 19, or 20 with ranged weapons in the chosen group. Ranger requirements apply (see references/ranger.md).

talents.name: Ranged Weapon Specialization (weapon group)
talents.description: Requires Weapon Focus with a weapon group that contains a ranged weapon. Gain +2d6p on weapon experience dice rolls with ranged weapons in the chosen group. Ranger requirements apply (see references/ranger.md).

talents.name: Ranged Weapon Supremacy (weapon group)
talents.description: Requires Ranged Weapon Specialization with the specified weapon group. Increase maximum mastery tier from +5 to +6 with ranged weapons in the chosen group. Ranger requirements apply (see references/ranger.md).

talents.name: Slayer of Beasts
talents.description: On a successful hit, gain +1 damage per three full levels against non-fantastical animals. Ranger requirements apply (see references/ranger.md).

talents.name: Slayer of Foes
talents.description: On a successful hit, gain +1 damage per three full levels against monstrous humanoids. Ranger requirements apply (see references/ranger.md).

talents.name: Slayer of Monsters
talents.description: Requires Slayer of Beasts and Slayer of Foes. On a successful hit, gain +1 damage per three full levels against fantastical animals and monsters. Ranger requirements apply (see references/ranger.md).

talents.name: Swift Tracker
talents.description: Pick up a trail in 20 minutes; at 15th level, only 10 minutes. Ranger requirements apply (see references/ranger.md).

talents.name: Assassination
talents.description: Requires 6th level. Reduce a nearhuman biped opponent's Threshold of Pain by 1 per two levels (rounded up). Damage results far exceeding the ToP threshold impose silence, unconsciousness, or bleeding out based on the margin. Usable with ranged weapons only within 20 feet. Rogue requirements apply (see references/rogue.md).

talents.name: Backstab
talents.description: When striking an unaware opponent in melee with a size S small sword, inflict penetrating damage on the max die roll and the roll minus 1. At 9th level add 1d4p extra damage; at 17th level add 2d4p. Supplemental dice penetrate on 3 or 4. Rogue requirements apply (see references/rogue.md).

talents.name: Coup de Grace
talents.description: Dispatch incapacitated opponents in 3 seconds. Rogue requirements apply (see references/rogue.md).

talents.name: Deadly Poison
talents.description: Requires Advanced Botany and Advanced Craft (Poison). Poisons you create gain +1 Virulence Factor; at 13th level this improves to +2. Rogue requirements apply (see references/rogue.md).

talents.name: Devious
talents.description: Requires evil alignment. No honor hits for poisoning sentient creatures. Rogue requirements apply (see references/rogue.md).

talents.name: Fleeing Opponent
talents.description: Requires Backstab. Strike a fleeing opponent as if performing a backstab with any weapon; supplemental backstab damage dice do not apply. Rogue requirements apply (see references/rogue.md).

talents.name: Knowledge
talents.description: Rogues sometimes know useless bits of trivia and background history (3% chance per level, subject to the GM's secret percentile roll). Rogue requirements apply (see references/rogue.md).

talents.name: Hide in Shadows
talents.description: Gain a +50 bonus to hiding and sneaking checks in dim light or darker. Rogue requirements apply (see references/rogue.md).

talents.name: Rapid Intoxication
talents.description: Requires 6th level, Advanced Botany, and Advanced Craft (Poison). Poisons you create take effect after 60 seconds; at 9th level this is 30 seconds, and at 12th level it is 10 seconds. Rogue requirements apply (see references/rogue.md).

talents.name: Rearward Strike
talents.description: When striking from behind with a melee weapon 3 feet or shorter, subtract 1 DR per two full levels. Rogue requirements apply (see references/rogue.md).

talents.name: Sudden Degeneration
talents.description: Requires 10th level, Expert Botany, and Expert Craft (Poison). Poisons you create have progression time reduced from 10 seconds to 5. Rogue requirements apply (see references/rogue.md).

talents.name: Superior Defense
talents.description: Near-perfect defense on a natural 18 or 19 that exceeds the opponent's attack roll. Successful counter-blow rolls 2d4p damage instead of 2(d4p-2). Rogue requirements apply (see references/rogue.md).

talents.name: Adaptation
talents.description: Reserve up to 3 free BP per character level (starting with your current free BP). You may learn and unlearn proficiencies and talents at the beginning of each new day with this pool, as long as you adhere to prerequisites. Track the proficiencies and talents purchased with this pool.

talents.name: Destined
talents.description: Once per day, any effect that would kill you instead reduces you to 1 hit point away from death and leaves you stable. Effects that kill you without reducing hit points still function normally.

talents.name: Determined
talents.description: Once per encounter, after a failed attack or saving throw, roll 1d4p and add it as a bonus to potentially alter the result.

talents.name: Improvisation
talents.description: You are considered unskilled with even non-universal skills, and you use twice your weakest ability score to determine what you roll against for unskilled skill checks.

talents.name: Versatility
talents.description: You receive no penalty for using weapons you do not have proficiency with. You must still be proficient to benefit from mastery.

talents.name: Inheritor
talents.description: You receive a +1 bonus to each of your saving throws.

talents.name: Natural Attunement
talents.description: Gain a -1 bonus to speed while in natural surroundings. Armeroci only.

talents.name: Natural Protection
talents.description: Gain a +1 bonus to DR while in natural surroundings. Armeroci only.

talents.name: Natural Awareness
talents.description: Gain a -2 bonus to initiative while in natural surroundings. Armeroci only.

talents.name: Warrior Woad
talents.description: Requires Average Artistry (painting). Apply warpaint over 10 minutes. After taking at least 1 point of piercing or hacking damage, add d6 to Strength and gain +6 Defense for 5d12p seconds. On expiration, succeed at Physical and Mental saving throws vs d20p+11 or fall unconscious for about an hour. Armeroci only.

talents.name: Huntsman
talents.description: Requires Average Hunting. If not engaged in melee, take 5 seconds to designate a visible creature as your quarry. Gain +1 to hit your quarry, and tracking them is 15% easier until you next rest or designate another target. Fymblwngen only.

talents.name: Huntsmaster
talents.description: Requires Advanced Hunting. Double quarry benefits and maintain two quarries simultaneously; choose one to drop when designating a new creature. Fymblwngen only.

talents.name: Ysgrewng
talents.description: Requires Expert Fymblwngish. Let loose a battle roar at combat onset to force a morale check for intelligent humanoids within 25 feet (except other Fymblwngen). Failure reduces morale by one increment; cowardly opponents flee on failure. Fymblwngen only.

talents.name: Defiant
talents.description: When an enemy scores a critical hit against you, they roll damage twice and take the weaker result before determining critical severity and additional effects. Fymblwngen only.

talents.name: Contender
talents.description: Gain Deceptive Defender and Precision Combatant at no BP cost; refund their BP costs if you already had them. Ithican only.

talents.name: Duelist
talents.description: Requires Contender. You no longer suffer defense penalties while attempting a called shot. Gain Combat Expertise at no BP cost; refund its BP cost if already owned. Ithican only.

talents.name: Haggler
talents.description: Requires 13+ Charisma. Gain a free purchase of Salesmanship at each level (retroactive). Ithican only.

talents.name: Deliberate
talents.description: You no longer fumble attack rolls on natural 1s; they are misses instead. Ithican only.

talents.name: Ever Ready
talents.description: Readying a weapon or shield takes you at most 1 second. Kanian only.

talents.name: Saddleborn
talents.description: Requires Advanced Riding. You are no longer thrown from your mount due to failed Riding checks when performing tactical mounted maneuvers. Kanian only.

talents.name: Beastwall
talents.description: Gain +1 to defense rolls against non-human opponents. Kanian only.

talents.name: Isolation
talents.description: Deal an additional 2 points of melee damage when your engaged opponent has no allies within 10 feet. Kanian only.

talents.name: Groin Stomp
talents.description: Can only be used on prone, knocked down, or sleeping opponents. A successful attack stuns for 2d8p seconds and deals d4 damage per stomp. While the opponent is on the ground, you can repeat every 10 seconds until unconsciousness. Victim loses a point of Honor. Katlakehan only.

talents.name: Project Confidence
talents.description: Giving Ground no longer halves Aggressive Attack damage, only Scampering Back does. Gain an additional +1 to hit while Aggressive Attacking (total +6). Katlakehan only.

talents.name: Raconteur
talents.description: Requires 13+ Charisma. Gain a free purchase of Distraction and Fast Talking at each level (retroactive). Katlakehan only.

talents.name: Edge Counter
talents.description: When you land a riposte via Perfect Defense, you automatically critically hit. Katlakehan only.

talents.name: Common
talents.description: Requires Looks between 8 and 12. Gain Forgettable Face at no BP cost; refund its BP cost if already owned. Midlander only.

talents.name: Solid
talents.description: Increase hit points by 8. Midlander only.

talents.name: Worker
talents.description: Gain two free purchases of either Agriculture, Animal Herding, Animal Husbandry, Blacksmithing, Carpentry, Cooking, Craft, Forestry, Leatherworking, or Pottery at each level (retroactive). Midlander only.

talents.name: Remarkability
talents.description: Must have at least one ability score (aside from Looks) under 10. Treat each modifier (except saving throws) as 1 better if you have a bonus, or 1 worse if you have a penalty. Reduce all ability scores by 1, aside from Looks. Midlander only.

talents.name: Educated
talents.description: Gain a free purchase of any two different skills where Intelligence is the sole relevant attribute at each level (retroactive). Pather only.

talents.name: Pedestrian
talents.description: Increase the weight you can carry before being lightly or moderately encumbered by 50% (rounded down). Pather only.

talents.name: Pilgrim
talents.description: Recovery time after failing a trauma check is 2 seconds times the difference between the 1/2 Con check and the 1/2 Con score. Rolling a 20 on trauma checks leaves you unconscious for d6p minutes. Pather only.

talents.name: Armored to the Teeth
talents.description: Requires heavy armor proficiency. Gain +1 to your damage modifier while wearing heavy armor. Pather only.

talents.name: Ironworker
talents.description: Requires Average Blacksmithing. Gain a free purchase of either Armorsmithing or Weaponsmithing at each level (retroactive). Vetlander only.

talents.name: Presence
talents.description: Charisma is considered 3 points higher when determining your morale modifier. Vetlander only.

talents.name: Wetlands Immunity
talents.description: Requires 12+ Constitution. Gain a +5 bonus to all communicability and severity checks against disease. Vetlander only.

talents.name: Marshstep
talents.description: You can move at jogging pace instead of walking pace when using Tactical Move, Give Ground, and Fighting Withdrawal. Engaged opponents may pursue if their speed permits it. Vetlander only.

talents.name: Gentle Tumble
talents.description: You can fall twice as far. You also no longer suffer damage from falls of up to 10 feet. Limmtrig only.

talents.name: Jack
talents.description: Gain an additional 1 LP per level (retroactive). Limmtrig only.

talents.name: Sapdrinker
talents.description: Each day you consume a pint of sap, heal an additional 1 point on each wound. Limmtrig only.

talents.name: Sapblood
talents.description: Requires Sapdrinker. Broken bones heal and limbs can regrow in about a week while maintaining the sap diet. Heal an additional 1 point on each wound each day you consume a pint of sap. Limmtrig only.

talents.name: Stumbling Gait
talents.description: Tactical Move no longer penalizes defense, only attack. Limmtrig only.

talents.name: Wooden Familiarity
talents.description: Gain a -1 bonus to speed with wooden weapons or hafts. Wooden shields have the Damage Reduction of metal shields in your hands. Limmtrig only.

talents.name: Stargazer
talents.description: Requires Average Astrology. You may consult the stars to guide your actions into the next day when you can observe a clear night sky. After doing so, roll 1d6. On a 1, you receive a 5% penalty to Intelligence-related skills. On a 2, nothing happens. On a 3, 4, or 5, you receive a 5% bonus to Intelligence-related skills. On a 6, the bonus is 10%. This modifier lasts until the next night. Qaraz only.

talents.name: Astrologue
talents.description: Requires Stargazer and Advanced Astrology. A 5% bonus is granted to each of Stargazer's d6 results (removing the penalty from a result of 1, and improving all other results). In addition, once per week, you can spend an hour to attempt to read the heavens for advice about a particular event or goal that will occur within 1 week. A secret Astrology check is rolled; on a success you uncover a clue or advice that could help, but on a failure the clue or advice will be misleading. Qaraz only.

talents.name: Medicant
talents.description: Requires Average First Aid. You can perform critical care at twice the speed, and it restores 1d3p points of damage from the wound instead of 1. Each individual wound may still only be treated once. In addition, while you are performing caregiver duties, you reduce the number of rest days required by an additional one per category. Qaraz only.

talents.name: Blinding Strike
talents.description: Requires 13+ Dexterity. Upon engaging in melee, you may choose to perform a contested attack roll against your opponent. The loser treats their attack roll as if it were a defense roll, and the winner lands a strike as normal. Neither of you receive another attack on the following second, regardless of weapon reach. This maneuver may not be performed if you cannot reach your opponent with your remaining movement when you engage (e.g. against spears or polearms). Qaraz only.

talents.name: Poisonous Bite
talents.description: Your fangs are now poisonous, but you may still perform dry bites if you wish. The virulence factor of your poison is 9, and it can cause weakness, dizziness, headaches, breathing difficulty, nausea and death (effect 3). Qaraz only.

talents.name: Revelator
talents.description: As long as you have evidence on your person that proves at least one of your conspiracy theories to be irrefutably true, you will no longer suffer migraines. If you help stop the perpetrators of your theory, you no longer need to carry around proof, can remove the Migraines flaw permanently, and gain a permanent +1 to your Charisma. Qaraz only.

talents.name: Winged
talents.description: Must be chosen within character creation and is mutually exclusive with Wingless. You may use your large bat-like wings to glide. You may glide 1 foot down for every 2 feet of forward movement in one second, or dive 1 foot for every 1 foot traveled forward. You may also turn while aerial and diving in the same manner as horses, with the same facing restrictions and turning diameters (no ride check necessary). Glide: Flutter (walk) 2 1/2 across, 1 1/4 down; Drift (jog) 5 across, 2 1/2 down; Fly (run) 7 1/2 across, 3 3/4 down; Soar (sprint) 10 across, 5 down. Dive: Flutter 2 1/2 across, 2 1/2 down; Drift 5 across, 5 down; Fly 7 1/2 across, 7 1/2 down; Soar 10 across, 10 down. Cirodes only.

talents.name: Strengthened Wings
talents.description: Requires Winged. In addition to using your wings to glide and dive, you may now fly forward and climb. You can also fly in place, but you cannot gain or lose altitude while hovering; forward momentum is required. To begin flying, you must have a running start. Climb: Flutter 7 1/2 across, 3 3/4 up; Drift 10 across, 5 up; Fly 12 1/2 across, 6 1/4 up; Soar 15 across, 7 1/2 up. Straight: Flutter 15 across; Drift 20 across; Fly 25 across; Soar 30 across. Glide: Flutter 7 1/2 across, 3 3/4 down; Drift 10 across, 5 down; Fly 12 1/2 across, 6 1/4 down; Soar 15 across, 7 1/2 down. Dive: Flutter 7 1/2 across, 7 1/2 down; Drift 10 across, 10 down; Fly 12 1/2 across, 12 1/2 down; Soar 15 across, 15 down. Cirodes only.

talents.name: Aerial Mobility
talents.description: Requires Strengthened Wings. You double the degrees you can turn while flying. In addition, you may climb straight up while hovering at half speed. Lastly, you can now dive down at full speed without needing forward momentum, although you will still take fall damage if you dive straight into the ground. Cirodes only.

talents.name: Wingless
talents.description: Must be chosen within character creation and is mutually exclusive with Winged. Unfettered by wings, your Dexterity is improved by 2. Cirodes only.

talents.name: Terrifying
talents.description: You gain a +3 on mastery die rolls for Intimidate, in addition to a free Intimidate purchase at each level (retroactive). Cirodes only.

talents.name: Echolocation
talents.description: You may detect objects in your environment by sensing echoes from those objects by actively creating sounds. You can accurately determine the location and size of objects within 30 feet by interpreting the sound waves reflected off of them. This will not allow you to accurately locate things around corners or behind walls. Cirodes only.

talents.name: Nightstalker
talents.description: Requires Echolocation. You gain a +50 bonus to hiding and sneaking while within complete darkness. Cirodes only.

talents.name: Light Adaptation
talents.description: Your eyes have adapted to sunlight and other bright lights. You no longer receive a penalty to attack in bright light. Cirodes only.

talents.name: Wild Athleticism
talents.description: Your natural muscularity improves your speed by one step. Cirodes only.

talents.name: Leaper
talents.description: Your jump and leap distances are tripled. Cirodes only.

talents.name: Bloodline
talents.description: Must be chosen within character creation. Gain a benefit based on your line: Virovoi: 1 free Survival skill purchase. Seskovoi: 1 free Persuasion skill purchase. Krastovoi: 1 free Intimidation skill purchase. Askotoi: 1 free Sneaking skill purchase. Linelost: 1 free First Aid skill purchase. Vorova only.

talents.name: Lithe
talents.description: Requires female. Gain +1 to your dodge saving throw. Vorova only.

talents.name: Sturdy
talents.description: Requires male. You are considered size large for knock backs. Vorova only.

talents.name: Heat Adaptation
talents.description: Mutually exclusive with Frostheart. Reduce heat penalties by 1/5% (no penalty at 30C, only -1/5% at 40C+). Save vs fire and heat at -2 instead of -4, and no longer suffer additional fire/heat damage. Vorova only.

talents.name: Hibernate
talents.description: On a failed trauma check, you may enter catalepsy for one hour. You retain hearing and smell but not sight or touch, can feign death, and toxins are held in check. You can enter or end hibernation at will; changing states takes 1 minute. Vorova only.

talents.name: Endure
talents.description: Requires Hibernate. You automatically enter catalepsy when knocked unconscious and are nearly impossible to distinguish from the dead by mundane means. You do not succumb to wounds unless suffering internal hemorrhaging or severe bleeding. Vorova only.

talents.name: Frostheart
talents.description: Mutually exclusive with Heat Adaptation. Your cold-related benefits are tripled, but so are your heat-related penalties. Vorova only.

talents.name: Power Within
talents.description: Gain a benefit based on your line: Virovoi: +1 defense. Seskovoi: +2 mental saving throw. Krastovoi: +2 physical saving throw. Askotoi: +1 damage modifier. Linelost: resist pain (double your ToP target number). Vorova only.

talents.name: Iron Heart
talents.description: A hard-won veteran instinct from campaign events. Gain +2 max HP.

talents.name: Ashen Stride
talents.description: You learn to drive through smoke and chaos. Gain +1 weapon speed bonus with a chosen weapon.

talents.name: Quickened Sight
talents.description: Reflexive threat reading from hard encounters. Gain +1 initiative modifier.

talents.name: Stoneguard
talents.description: Your stance hardens after surviving a brutal ordeal. Gain +1 DR.

talents.name: River Footing
talents.description: Learned balance under pressure grants +1 defense with a chosen weapon.

talents.name: Blooded Edge
talents.description: A sharper killing line from decisive encounters. Gain +1 damage with a chosen weapon.

talents.name: Storm Arm
talents.description: Your attacks become cleaner and faster under duress. Gain +1 weapon attack bonus.

talents.name: Far Mark
talents.description: Calibrated aim from repeated long-distance engagements.

talents.name: Steady Guard
talents.description: Disciplined shield use grants +1 shield defense.

talents.name: Fast Healing (Event)
talents.description: Your recovery improves after a significant campaign milestone.

talents.name: Braced Reach
talents.description: You learn to command distance. Gain +1 reach with melee weapons.

talents.name: Hardened Plate
talents.description: You adapt your armor work in the field. Gain +1 DR while armored.

talents.name: Curse of Axe
talents.description: You are compelled to wield a +2 greataxe. Its 3d6p damage dice penetrate on 4, 5, or 6.
